s3.title: List S3 buckets and find each bucket Region

verification.text: Confirm the S3 bucket is listed and accessible in the S3 console.
Verify that GetBucketLocation or bucket properties confirm the Region is 'eu-west-2'.
Verify that Object Storage settings match the expected requirements.
Confirm object operations and versioning rules execute without permission errors.
Verify that server-side encryption and access logging are enabled as specified.
Confirm bucket policy, public access block, and CORS configuration match lab settings.

cleanup.text: No AWS resources were created during this lab, so no cleanup is required.

ec2.title: Launch an EC2 instance using the AWS Console

verification.text: Confirm the EC2 instance status shows 'Running' in the EC2 Management Console.
Verify system status checks and instance status checks report 2/2 checks passed.
Confirm security group inbound rules permit required ports for Elastic Compute Cloud.
Verify key pair association, Elastic IP, or attached EBS volumes are active.

cleanup.text: Terminate the EC2 instance created during this lab and wait for state to show Terminated.
Release any Elastic IP addresses allocated during this lab.

verification.text: Virtual Private Cloud configuration verified in Amazon VPC.

cleanup.text: Delete subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, and the custom VPC created during this lab.
Delete the NAT Gateway and wait for state to show Deleted before releasing the associated Elastic IP.
